old_problem: The historical record retained Pending for vendor warm-reset readiness, service timeline, independent recovery and Project invariants. IPMI defines App NetFn 0x06 command 0x03 as Warm Reset intended to clean internal device and communication-interface state, distinct from Cold Reset. Exact service order/timers and expected preserved settings are normal firmware-bound inputs.
disposition_reason: Issue raw 0x06/0x03 exactly once after approval and independently prove the warm-reset-specific communication-interface restart and staged recovery of required IPMI/Redfish/WebUI/SOL services. Verify MAC/IP and approved persistent configuration plus host power/boot continuity. Do not infer a cold-reset initialization, use the preceding case's evidence, promote DeepSeek's 30-second sleep to an SLA, or fall back to cold reset/host power.
decision_basis: XLSX row 994, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 995 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 995 / variant 7f821fe8f0c3434d.

IPMI v2.0 section 20.3 states that Warm Reset cleans internal device state and communication interfaces. It is a separate command from section 20.2 Cold Reset and does not authorize assuming the cold-reset power-up-default sequence.

Because communication interfaces are the function being reset, a single returning `mc info` response can precede other management services. Project-defined staged readiness and a stabilization window are required to prove BMC functionality.

The source requires stable MAC/IP and unaffected system power. Independent before/during/after observers must compare network/config and prove no host power or boot transition while the BMC interfaces restart.

ED-06, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-24, ED-26 through ED-28 and ED-30 preserve exact warm-reset identity, service-level evidence, recovery and no retry; ED-33 through ED-38 permit Project parameterization with explicit confirmation.

test_case.test_name: Verify one in-band IPMI BMC warm reset and staged communication-service recovery
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact BMC accepts one standard in-band Warm Reset, cleans/restarts its management communication interfaces, returns all required services with unchanged MAC/IP and persistent configuration, and does not alter the SUT host power or boot instance.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/local-IPMI/management-endpoint identity, firmware-documented warm-reset support and pinned ipmitool/parser/reviewed Script revision
Baseline Get Device ID, MAC, IPv4/IPv6/VLAN/channel, certificate/endpoint, approved persistent settings, IPMI/Redfish/WebUI/SOL service and health evidence with preserved SEL/audit logs
Independent management-network plus host/console observers capable of recording interface outage/order of return without using the resetting localhost IPMI session
Owner-defined service-by-service readiness and stabilization sequence/timeouts for this firmware; DeepSeek's 30 seconds is historical only
Initial/final host power rule and, if On, continuous boot ID/uptime/service evidence; if Off, continuous Off evidence
Protected local execution, maintenance window, drained management sessions, explicit one-reset approval and a warm-reset-specific recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Verify the DUT/BMC/local-IPMI mapping and independent observers; preserve logs and capture BMC identity, network/persistent configuration, each required management service/health and host power/boot baseline. Drain active management operations. After explicit approval send exactly one protected local `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x03` and capture completion. Independently record the warm communication-interface outage/reset witness, then poll each approved service to readiness in its observed order until bounded timeouts and continue through stabilization. Recompare exact MAC/IP/VLAN/channel/certificate and persistent settings. Concurrently prove the host never changed power; if On, boot ID/uptime and services remain continuous, and if Off it remains Off. Preserve expected/unexpected logs. Stop on failure; never send cold reset, host power or a second warm reset automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The single Warm Reset is accepted; the intended BMC communication interfaces show a reset/restart and every required management service returns and remains stable within its approved firmware-specific bounds. BMC identity, MAC/IP and persistent settings are unchanged, and the host retains its original power state and boot instance. Only expected warm-reset events occur and no service or alarm remains degraded.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target, approval, one raw 0x06/0x03 request, accepted completion, independent warm-interface restart witness, complete staged service readiness/stabilization, unchanged MAC/IP/configuration and unchanged host power/boot. Fixed 30-second sleep, ping, first `mc info`, cold-reset evidence or command acknowledgement alone cannot pass. Timeout, partial service return, identity/config drift, host transition or unexpected alarm is FAIL; missing timers/mappings is NOT READY rather than Pending.
safety_gate: Require explicit confirmation immediately before the warm reset after rechecking exact target, management-session drain, independent observers and recovery access.
Use protected local/verified access; prohibit sshpass, plaintext credentials and host-key bypass.
Preserve logs and per-service baseline; do not clear evidence or assume all interfaces are ready when the first one responds.
Deny cold reset, host reset/power, AC/DC cycle and arbitrary raw commands; another reset is not automatic recovery.
Stop on unsupported/ambiguous completion, missing warm-reset witness, any service timeout, network/config drift, host power/boot change or alarm. Do not retry automatically.
Any recovery mutation requires separate incident authorization and cannot count as this warm-reset result.
expected_evidence: Approval, exact DUT/BMC/local-IPMI/observer identities and pinned firmware/tool/parser/Script versions
Pre-reset network/persistent config, per-service/health, preserved logs and host power/boot baseline
Redacted raw request/completion plus timestamped communication-interface outage and staged IPMI/Redfish/WebUI/SOL return
Post-stabilization service health and exact MAC/IP/configuration comparison
Host power/boot/service continuity or continuous-Off proof, expected-event/no-retry audit and engineer verdict distinct from Cold Reset
test_case.recovery: On incomplete warm-service recovery or invariant drift, stop without cold/warm reset or host power fallback, retain all evidence and keep the host in its current safe state. Use the approved independent management/console incident procedure under new authorization; verify every required interface and host invariant before closure and escalate any persistent failure.

source_conflict.reason: The Warm Reset command and network/host invariants are coherent. DeepSeek's fixed sleep and shallow post-check do not create an authoritative conflict.
